svg.title: NFSU2 Native Rust Migration & Subsystem Coverage
svg.desc: 67 pure Rust, 1 hybrid, 0 pending out of 68 tracked modules (99.3% weighted coverage).
svg.text: NFSU2 Native Rust Migration & Subsystem Coverage
Pure Rust Performance Engines, SIMD Pipelines & Driver Shims
Migration status and conversion coverage from C/C++/Java into high-performance, memory-safe Rust crates.
Each tile represents a converted module or SIMD pipeline. Hover over cells for implementation details.
